scene: Behind the stage, a bustling service junction reveals three surprising transit gates.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view of a subterranean brick junction. On the left stands a brass book cart lift with open cage doors. The player in his teal bomber jacket stands centre-left. In the centre waits a striped bicycle rickshaw with its driver. On the right, a glowing ferris wheel gondola sits docked beside an archway.
shown: a mechanical brass book cart lift with open metal gates on the left
a striped bicycle rickshaw with a nodding driver waiting in the centre
